value.rationale: Natural complete classification for the three-color magnetic Potts model on all strictly unequal complete tripartite graphs. Both crossing occupation polynomials are exact closed forms; their exponential degeneracies and intermediate-field free-color phase give nontrivial size-dependent residual entropy, including an ordering inversion criterion at \( eta/\gamma=\log3/\log2\). This is more than a one-graph count or merely rewriting the partition function, while remaining confined to a clear dense-graph model.
